List and Register Color Themes

Source: R/colortheme_registry.R
colorthemes.Rd

colorthemes() returns a data frame listing available color themes in the registry. register_colortheme() registers a custom color theme into the registry.

Usage

colorthemes(name = NULL, source = NULL, type = NULL, env = NULL)

register_colortheme(
  kernel,
  kernel.args = list(),
  options = list(),
  name = "newtheme",
  source = "custom",
  type = NULL,
  env = NULL
)

Arguments

name

for colorthemes(), a character vector of theme names to match (case-insensitive prefix matching). For register_colortheme(), a single string for the new theme name.

source

for colorthemes(), a character vector of sources to match (case-insensitive prefix matching). For register_colortheme(), a single string for the source name.

type

a character string or vector specifying the theme type(s): "sequential", "diverging", or "qualitative".

env

an environment where color themes are registered. Defaults to the package registry (getOption("colortheme.registry")).

kernel

a color vector, a palette function, a ramp function, a "colortheme" object, or a length-2 character vector/list for lazy evaluation. If NULL, the theme is removed.

kernel.args

a list of arguments passed to the color kernel.

options

a list of option values controlling the color theme's behavior.

Value

  • colorthemes(): A data frame with columns "name", "source", and "type".

  • register_colortheme(): Invisibly returns the metadata of the previous theme that was overwritten (or NULL if none existed).

Details

colorthemes() extracts metadata from the registry environment and structures it into a data frame, allowing users to discover themes by name, source, and type (with case-insensitive prefix matching).

register_colortheme() takes a color vector, a color-generating function, or an existing "colortheme" object and registers it under a specified name and source (defaulting to "custom/newtheme"). To keep the registry lightweight, the kernel argument supports lazy loading: pass a character vector or list of length 2 where the first element is an R expression returning a kernel (e.g., "rainbow") and the second is the namespace (e.g., "grDevices").

See also

colortheme

Examples

# List all available themes
head(colorthemes())
#>            name    source      type
#> 1      ArmyRose grDevices diverging
#> 2        Berlin grDevices diverging
#> 3      Blue-Red grDevices diverging
#> 4    Blue-Red 2 grDevices diverging
#> 5    Blue-Red 3 grDevices diverging
#> 6 Blue-Yellow 2 grDevices diverging

# Case-insensitive prefix matching
colorthemes(name = "ma")
#>      name      source       type
#> 1 managua      khroma  diverging
#> 2 Magenta   grDevices sequential
#> 3    Mako   grDevices sequential
#> 4   magma viridisLite sequential
#> 5    mako viridisLite sequential

# Register a custom theme
register_colortheme(
  kernel = c("#264653", "#2a9d8f", "#e9c46a", "#f4a261", "#e76f51"),
  name = "sand", source = "custom", type = "sequential"
)
colorthemes(name = "sand")
#>   name source       type
#> 1 sand custom sequential

# Remove the custom theme by passing NULL
register_colortheme(NULL, name = "sand", source = "custom")
